object_description: tall compact stack of alternating floor plates and glazed levels
design_condition: The building is placed beside the existing building at a respectful distance, exploiting the natural height difference with entrances at two levels and reshaping the surrounding landscape toward the lake.

positive.statement: The sensitive analysis of the place and the precise location along the new passage are appreciated.
The two entrances and the clarity of pedestrian circulation are well integrated into the site.
The underground base frees the building from disturbing volumetric annexes.
The supporting structure and architectural choices respond to the functional needs in a coherent and interesting way.
The project is recognized for its qualities of interior organization and exterior spaces.

negative.statement: The distance from the cantonal road is not respected, and the building's height would push it northward.
The jury questions whether such an iconic gesture is necessary.
The project offers little flexibility for future needs, and the effectiveness of an institution spanning three floors is questioned.
